name: Development Advisory Committee Meeting Agenda September 25, 2023
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE
  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
  STANDING DEVELOPMENT ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Monday, September 25, 2023 - 4:00 p.m.
  El Monte City Hall East
  City Manager’s Conference Room
  11333 Valley Boulevard
  El Monte, California

1.  CALL TO ORDER / FLAG SALUTE

2.  ROLL CALL

3.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  None

5.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  Members of the public may comment provided such comments are within the subject
  matter jurisdiction of the Committee. Speakers will be given 2 minutes to speak per
  person. The Committee may not deliberate or act upon matters not appearing on
  the agenda but may direct staff to place the matter on a future Committee agenda.

6.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS

  6.1  Update on 4350 Temple City Blvd. Prop 1 Groundwater Cleanup Grant

  6.2  Receive staff presentation and provide direction on proposed Flair Park Plan.

  6.3  Receive staff presentation and provide direction on proposed amendment to
  the Billboard Overlay Zone.

  6.4  Update on development projects.

7.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS

8.  ADJOURN MEETING

  Agenda Posted on September 20, 2023 at 11:20 a.m.
